items.item: PF-001/PF-002 submitFeature validates input, binds the request to a pf-canon-v1 repository snapshot, keeps the prompt with a redacted preview, and is idempotent
tests: PF-001 submit records a request bound to the repository snapshot, with the prompt kept and a redacted preview
PF-002 idempotent: same key and prompt replays; same key with a different prompt or repository is a conflict
input validation: empty, oversized, bad mode, missing key, unindexed repository, bad references

tests: S13/PF-043 tracking and mode: draft PR needs a git remote else it is lowered with the reason; mandatory tracking blocks mutation, not reading
AT-35/44 the private-prompt redaction masks secrets, personal data and opaque blobs before a preview can leave

items.item: Plan tier is classified from the actual change set and recorded once
tests: classifyPlan records the tier once and never from prompt text

tests: access: denied paths are left out of coverage and entities, counted in the gap, and never named

items.item: AT-33/S17 repository support matrix: unsupported stacks are reported with a concrete reason and block build modes, not plans

S17 stack detection: npm test script, bare node tests, invalid manifest, and unknown
the demo repo (no package.json) is a supported TypeScript/Node stack that tests with node --test, and the plan's npm-test assumption is recorded
